definitions: The quality or state of being different or diverse; the absence of uniformity, sameness, or monotony.
A number or collection of different things, especially of a particular class.
A thing which differs in some way from others of the same general class.
A type of entertainment consisting of a series of different acts, such as singing, dancing, and comedy.
examples: The shop sells a variety of goods.
He enjoys a variety of sports.
This is a new variety of rose.
They went to see a variety show.
